browser.name: ux-text
checks: load network failure uses Korean recovery guidance, does not claim saved, and explicit retry recovers
save-and-leave waits for acknowledgment, keeps assessment/drafts on failure, offers backup/retry, and exits only after success
320/390px at 100/200%: consistent tabs, Korean close name, truthful settings, no horizontal overflow, axe and state/revision unchanged
real saved history: mobile cards and desktop table disclose complete original long sentences/notes without modifying state or revision
completed lesson replay also discloses the original sentence and notes without a write
isolated real components: reload explains unsaved/busy guards; keyboard disclosure restores every original character safely
anonymous first visit has truthful sign-in guidance, no saved claim, and preserved source/license links

browser.name: state-roundtrip
checks: literal reserved senses: UI editing, saving, reload, validated export, actual restore and sense switching
5001st entry rejected by real server; modal explains the limit and retains input; original account/revision unchanged; 320/390/1440px and axe
all three contexts and reloads use local empty font CSS; no external font files

browser.name: image-practice-resume
checks: rapid navigation coalesces, closes while saving, resumes front, no history entries
tab return, reload and separate browser context resume same account
two devices conflict and both explicit choices work
same-browser tab lookup preserves another tab failed cursor across reload and recovery
late failed write cannot resurrect an older draft over another tab saved choice or auto-replay after reload
remote choice preserves later same-browser C-to-B-to-C pending cursor and reload needs a choice without PUT
write failure, lost response and timeout preserve position and retry reads first
first/last boundaries, strict integer jump and navigation through failed images
320/390/1440, 100/200% text, 44px targets, keyboard, focus return and axe
unknown initial server position cannot be overwritten after load failure
explicit current choice saves the displayed fallback card after conflict
excluded saved card advances in original order; empty deck and lookup never overwrite server cursor
new account starts at its own position; stale owner receives 401 and stops navigation/writes

browser.name: familiarity-reveal
checks: first presentation omits the meaning and dictionary links, including in the rendered card DOM
keyboard reveal compares the committed guess with the meaning without advancing or grading
another device restores the revealed meaning and the original pre-reveal guess
mismatched meaning becomes uncertain and the next word starts concealed with an empty guess
new words remain new after reading the answer and cannot become known immediately
a correct mental guess can be confirmed without making typing compulsory or fabricating recall scores
failed reveal save blocks confirmation until retry succeeds
server validation rejects promoting a previously new answer after reveal

browser.name: backup
checks: invalid JSON, unsupported version and broken references never reach the restore endpoint
preview shows exact impact; narrow screens, 200% text, backup download, required acknowledgment and cancel preserve data
confirmed restore atomically replaces settings, personal words, material, results, notes and resumable drafts
another device resumes the exact draft; an open lesson must save and return home before importing
stale revision refuses replacement and requires a server refresh before any new save
legacy backup is supported; a lost post-commit response is reconciled by GET without repeating replacement
server failure preserves current records and exposes a recovery path
a 3 MB+ UTF-8 backup crosses D1 chunk boundaries and restores all 650 records through the real Worker
explicitly confirmed empty backup removes only this synthetic account’s study records

browser.name: backup-safety
checks: changing the current snapshot invalidates an approved safety copy even inside final confirmation
730 sessions: whole and safety exports are compact and restorable; replace then recover and reload preserves all records
failed download blocks replacement; retry succeeds; changing the selected file resets proof and acknowledgment
valid accumulated records exceeding 8 MB block safety approval and replacement, keep server state unchanged, and remain exportable as an archive
blocked-state mobile/desktop layout and automated accessibility pass

browser.name: backup-workflow
checks: safety size/count/restorability precede downloading; keyboard download/acknowledgment, focus trap, 200% text and 320–1440 px work
revision conflicts before and after upload lead to a fresh server snapshot and discard obsolete staging only
an uncertain commit disables cancellation/replacement; server reload confirms the saved result without another commit
post-commit saves are included in the reloaded state and success counts; sentences, scores, settings and incomplete drafts survive
